name: Android Dev
postCreateCommand: mkdir -p $HOME/android-sdk/cmdline-tools && cd $HOME/android-sdk/cmdline-tools && wget -q https://dl.google.com/android/repository/commandlinetools-linux-11076708_latest.zip -O tools.zip && unzip -q tools.zip && rm tools.zip && mv cmdline-tools latest && yes | $HOME/android-sdk/cmdline-tools/latest/bin/sdkmanager --licenses > /dev/null 2>&1
